_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'blank' (site 2): languages, culture-variant Document Types, domains and templates are content/config, and site 2 has no starter kit whose own templates could satisfy the assertions. namespace is unused by these assets (a manifest, two partials — no .cs) but is how every manifest declares its example's identity. assets = the language + dictionary manifest and both partials, installed verbatim by ExampleMigrations.cs. No `requires`: this example seeds a SUBTREE under site 2's shared root (see ExampleHostWiring.cs), so there is no root-level alias to assert.
